response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/backend developer with strong web, mobile, and systems programming background, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D-lang ecosystems rather than C++. His only substantial C++ experience was a brief 6-month stint in 2014-2015 writing C/C++ components, and there is no evidence of IEC 62443, industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or the specific security/architecture focus this role demands.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience (15+ years) across many domains
Demonstrated experience with networking, async I/O, and high-performance/low-latency systems (in D, not C++)
Strong self-driven learner with public speaking, mentoring, and open-source leadership experience
concerns: Minimal recent C++ experience (last significant C++ work was ~2014-2015, briefly)
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards experience
No demonstrated background in industrial automation, IoT/MQTT, or protocols like Modbus/OPC UA/IEC 61850

key_factors.factor: Strong general senior engineering and system design background
